```{r }
#'This script returns one excel file 'summarizing_management_table.xlsx':
#This is an Excel file so that the symbol "≤" can be correctly stored and uploaded in Rshiny, this symbol can not be stored in a csv file.
#'
#'@param Targets_management_table.xlsx excel file describing project targets per species per RBU
#'@param occupancy_rel_RBSU.csv csv file descibing observations and occupancy per species per RBSU
#'@param RBSU_RIPARIAS_12_02_2021.geojson geojson file containing polygons at river basin subunit level, which is necessary to link each RBSU to an RBU

rm(list=ls())

#loading libraries####
library(googlesheets4)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

#import data
monitoring_data <- read_sheet("19oivHE5ljX0F4W8KtxpfQM_cPobogOM0US1W6edtLHw",
                      sheet = "plants",
                      col_types = "c")%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = `DAFOR 2023`,
         DAFOR_2026 = `DAFOR 2026 (before management)`)

monitoring_data <- monitoring_data%>%
  mutate(`Invasive species`= replace(`Invasive species`, `Invasive species`=="Reuzenbalsemien / Impatiens glandulifera", "Impatiens glandulifera"))%>%
  mutate(`Invasive species`= replace(`Invasive species`, `Invasive species`=="Reuzenberenklauw / Heracleum mantegazzianum", "Heracleum mantegazzianum"))%>%
  mutate(`Invasive species`= replace(`Invasive species`, `Invasive species`=="brede waterpest", "Elodea canadensis"))%>%
  mutate(`Invasive species`= replace(`Invasive species`, `Invasive species`=="smalle waterpest", "Elodea nuttallii"))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = replace(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2023=="O / Occasional / >5%", "Occasional (<5%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = replace(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2023=="F / Frequent / 5% - 25%", "Frequent (5-25%)"))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = replace(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2023=="F", "Frequent (5-25%)"))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = replace(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2023=="A / Abundant/ 25% - 50%" , "Abundant (25-50%)"))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = replace(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2023=="A" , "Abundant (25-50%)"))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = replace(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2023=="D / Dominant / >50%" , "Dominant (> 50%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = replace(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2023=="D" , "Dominant (> 50%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = replace(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2023=="Occasional (<5%)" , "Rare (<5%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = replace(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2023=="R" , "Rare (<5%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = replace(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2023=="Abundant / Dominant (depending on quadrat)" , "Abundant (25-50%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2023 = replace(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2023=="Frequent to Dominant" , "Abundant (25-50%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="O / Occasional / >5%", "Occasional (<5%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="F / Frequent / 5% - 25%", "Frequent (5-25%)"))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="F", "Frequent (5-25%)"))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="A / Abundant/ 25% - 50%" , "Abundant (25-50%)"))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="A" , "Abundant (25-50%)"))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="D / Dominant / >50%" , "Dominant (> 50%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="D" , "Dominant (> 50%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="Occasional (<5%)" , "Rare (<5%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="R" , "Rare (<5%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="Abundant / Dominant (depending on quadrat)" , "Abundant (25-50%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="Frequent to Dominant" , "Abundant (25-50%)" ))%>%
  mutate(DAFOR_2026 = replace(DAFOR_2026, DAFOR_2026=="X" , NA ))

dafor_levels <- c("Absent", "Rare (<5%)", "Frequent (5-25%)",
                  "Abundant (25-50%)", "Dominant (> 50%)")

clean_dafor <- function(x) {
  x <- stringr::str_squish(as.character(x))
  x <- dplyr::case_when(
    x %in% c("R", "O", "O / Occasional / >5%", "Occasional (<5%)") ~ "Rare (<5%)",
    x %in% c("F", "F / Frequent / 5% - 25%") ~ "Frequent (5-25%)",
    x %in% c("A", "A / Abundant/ 25% - 50%",
             "Abundant / Dominant (depending on quadrat)",
             "Frequent to Dominant") ~ "Abundant (25-50%)",
    x %in% c("D", "D / Dominant / >50%") ~ "Dominant (> 50%)",
    x == "X" ~ NA_character_,
    TRUE ~ x
  )
  factor(x, levels = dafor_levels)
}

monitoring_clean <- monitoring_data %>%
  mutate(across(c(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2026), clean_dafor))
  

#check data
unique(monitoring_data$`Invasive species`)
unique(monitoring_data$DAFOR_2023)
unique(monitoring_data$DAFOR_2026)

monitoring_long <- monitoring_clean %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(DAFOR_2023, DAFOR_2026),
    names_to = "Time_period2",
    names_prefix = "DAFOR_",
    values_to = "DAFOR"
  )

monitoring_data_summary <- monitoring_long %>%
  dplyr::count(Time_period2, `Invasive species`, DAFOR, name = "count") %>%
  rename(species = `Invasive species`)


sub_data <- monitoring_data_summary%>%
  filter(species == "Hydrocotyle ranunculoides")

test <- ggplot(sub_data, 
               aes(fill=DAFOR, 
                   y=count, 
                   x=factor(Time_period2,
                            level = c('2023','2026')))) + 
    geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity")+
    labs(y='Number of sites')+
    labs(x='Time period')+
    theme_bw()

show(test)

monitoring_data_summary <- monitoring_data_summary%>%
  rename(Time_period = Time_period2)
#export sub_data
write.csv(monitoring_data_summary, '~/GitHub/riparias-prep/data/interim/dafor_monitoring.csv', row.names=FALSE)
```
